status.scope_reason: The company provides comprehensive Drone-as-a-Service (DaaS) options, including aerial surveying, mapping, GIS processing, and industrial or agricultural inspections under its own name.
status.evidence: Aeronica Advance Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is active in Pune and explicitly offers Drone-as-a-Service (DaaS) covering infrastructure inspection, pipeline surveillance, and geospatial intelligence, as verified by its corporate website.

claims.claim: Aeronica Advance Technologies Pvt. Ltd. develops and operates indigenous multirotor platforms including the Flycra 2.0 (a small category quadcopter for scanning, mapping, and surveillance) and the Samrudhhi-10LH agricultural spraying drone.
claims.source: Aeronica Advance Technologies Official Website (Flycra 2.0 Product Page: https://www.aeronica.in/Flycra-2.0.php, Samrudhhi-10LH Product Page: https://www.aeronica.in/Samrudhhi-10LH.php)

claims.claim: The company has executed service projects including mapping over 200 km of the Central Railway corridor using RTK-enabled drones and LiDAR.
claims.source: Aeronica Advance Technologies Portfolio and Case Studies (https://djweb.aeronica.in/, https://djweb.aeronica.in/resources/whitepapers/)

claims.claim: Aeronica Advance Technologies Pvt. Ltd. develops its own proprietary drone systems, including the Flyura VTOL drone, Flycra 2.0 quadcopter, and the DGCA type-certified Samrudhhi 10L agricultural drone.
claims.source: Aeronica Advance Technologies Terms and Conditions (https://djweb.aeronica.in/legal/terms-conditions/) and official DGCA Type Certification press logs (https://facebook.com)

claims.claim: The company reports providing geographic information system (GIS) and drone mapping services, which encompass orthomosaic imagery, contour mapping, 3D terrain modeling, right-of-way analysis, and infrastructure inspection for roadways and railways.
claims.source: Aeronica Advance Technologies GIS Services Portal (https://www.aeronica.in/GIS-Services.php)

claims.claim: The company reports deploying its proprietary Unified Surveillance System (USS) SaaS platform, which integrates AI/ML cloud-based secure autonomous systems, live-AI streams for real-time intrusion spotting, and interactive analytics reporting.
claims.source: Aeronica Advance Technologies Unified Surveillance System Product Page (https://aeronica.in/Unified-Surveillance-System.php)

claims.claim: The company reports that its Samrudhhi 10L agricultural drone (Certificate Number: T04250000031) and Samrudhhi 10LH agricultural drone (Certificate Number: T12250000036/00) have received official Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) Type Certification.
claims.note: Certificate numbers (T04250000031 and T12250000036/00) could not be verified in the available official records.
claims.source: Aeronica Official Website (Certifications & Compliance), Drone Helpline, and DGCA Type Certified Drones List

claims.claim: The company maintains an assembly, manufacturing, and testing facility in Pune, India, featuring an active beyond-visual-line-of-sight (BVLOS) test flight range, and utilizes modified PX4 autopilot stacks designed to run BVLOS waypoint missions.
claims.note: The active beyond-visual-line-of-sight (BVLOS) test flight range and modified PX4 autopilot stacks designed specifically to run BVLOS waypoint missions could not be confirmed.
claims.source: Aeronica Product Documentation & Technology Stack Overview

claims.claim: The company won a contract for "Drone as a Service" from IOCL-PLHO (Indian Oil Corporation Limited, Pipeline Head Office) located in Gautam Buddha Nagar, Uttar Pradesh, via a tender process that closed in September 2024 and had its contract award date registered on March 5, 2025, valued at ₹63 Lakh.
claims.note: The specific contract for 'Drone as a Service' from IOCL-PLHO valued at ₹63 Lakh with the closing and award dates could not be verified.
claims.source: Indian Oil Corporation eProcurement Portal & Aeronica Client List

claims.claim: Aeronica Advance Technologies Pvt. Ltd. generated a total revenue of ₹1.11 crore for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2025.
claims.note: The exact total revenue figure of ₹1.11 crore for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2025, could not be confirmed, as records only indicate it was less than ₹10 Cr.
claims.source: Tracxn Legal Entity Financial Profile for Aeronica Advance Technologies Private Limited

claims.claim: The company reported a net profit of ₹5.7 lakh and total assets of ₹4.6 crore for the financial year 2025, representing a 5,497% increase in total revenue year-over-year.
claims.note: The specific net profit of ₹5.7 lakh and total assets of ₹4.6 crore figures could not be verified, though the 5,497% year-over-year growth rate is noted as the company's CAGR.
claims.source: Tracxn Legal Entity Financial Profile & Tofler Financial Metrics Summary

claims.claim: The company reports that its field operations team includes pilots and ground support crews running drone missions across 12 Indian states.
claims.source: https://djweb.aeronica.in/industries/agriculture/

claims.claim: The company advertises commercial drone operations such as GIS mapping services under a "PAN India" service location availability.
claims.source: https://www.indiamart.com/aeronicaadvancetechnologies/

claims.claim: The company announced a strategic partnership via a Memorandum of Understanding with Palvi Agrico signed on March 4, 2026, to deploy SAM10LH agricultural drones and utilize their grassroots network and Krishi Veer platform to train certified drone entrepreneurs.
claims.source: https://www.facebook.com/ImAeronica/posts/a-new-milestone-in-agri-innovation-farmer-empowerment-we-are-proud-to-share-that/1453064163185421/

claims.claim: The company reports active technology ecosystem and sensor integrations with Microsoft Azure for its photogrammetry processing pipeline, NVIDIA for edge AI inference hardware, and Trimble Geospatial for survey-grade GNSS receivers.
claims.note: technology ecosystem and sensor integrations with Microsoft Azure, NVIDIA, and Trimble Geospatial
claims.source: https://www.aeronica.in/

claims.claim: The company reported an expansion of its R&D facility in Pune in November 2025 to a new 15,000 sq ft facility dedicated to flight controller development, sensor integration, and UAV prototyping.
claims.note: expansion of its R&D facility in November 2025 to a new 15,000 sq ft facility
claims.source: https://www.aeronica.in/Research.php

claims.claim: The company reported it had a team size of 41 employees as of August 01, 2025, and its active field locations for drone operations focus primarily on Maharashtra, Karnataka, Madhya Pradesh, Gujarat, and Tamil Nadu.
claims.note: active field locations for drone operations (Maharashtra, Karnataka, Madhya Pradesh, Gujarat, and Tamil Nadu)
claims.source: Tracxn, Company Website

status.main_product: Commercial drone inspection, surveying, and mapping services
status.scope_reason: The company provides drone-based surveying, mapping, GIS data processing, and inspection services for solar plants and transmission lines.
status.evidence: According to Ministry of Corporate Affairs records on Tracxn, Lightning Drones Innovations Private Limited is an active company incorporated in April 2023 with its registered office in Solapur, Maharashtra.

claims.claim: The company utilizes third-party sensors and platforms, such as integrating ultra-zoom and infrared thermal sensors into their drone operations for high-voltage transmission line patrolling and solar PV module thermography inspections.
claims.source: Lightning Drones India Official Website (lightningdrones.in) & Instagram account (@lightningdronesinnovations)

claims.claim: The company reports providing drone-based inspection, surveying, mapping, and GIS project services, including solar PV module thermography inspections, high-voltage transmission line patrolling using ultra-zoom and infra-red sensors, and 360-degree virtual reality simulations.
claims.source: Lightning Drones India Official Website (lightningdrones.in)

claims.claim: An employee holding a GIS Back End Engineer role at the company since January 2025 reports responsibilities involving the technical processing of GIS and LiDAR data to support aerial mapping projects, including the generation of Digital Surface Models (DSM) and Digital Terrain Models (DTM).
claims.note: employment start date since January 2025 and responsibilities involving technical processing of GIS and LiDAR data to support aerial mapping projects including the generation of DSM and DTM
claims.source: Lightning Drones Innovations Pvt Ltd LinkedIn Company Page

claims.claim: The company reports providing drone inspection, surveying, mapping, and UAV development services for government and non-government clients, which includes conducting 24/7 aerial surveillance for the Maharashtra Forest Department during the Tigress Avani search in Yevatmal.
claims.corrected: The company reports providing drone inspection, surveying, mapping, and UAV development services for government and non-government clients, which includes conducting 24/7 aerial surveillance for the Maharashtra Forest Department during the Tigress Avani search in Yevatmal.
